Professional Summary
Machine Learning Engineer with almost 5 years of experience building and deploying ML systems for security

Experience
Machine Learning EngineerJuly 2021 - Present
Intel Bangalore, India
1. Targeted Detector – Threat Detection Technology
• Designed, trained, and deployed ML models for real-time detection of cyber threats using CPU telemetry .

detection robustness.
• Performed extensive model evaluation and tuning using ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, F1-score, confusion matrix analysis,
and threshold/false-positive optimization to balance detection accuracy and reliability.
• Optimized model performance through hyperparameter tuning and algorithm selection, leading to improved detection
accuracy in production environments.

• Worked closely with security researchers and platform teams to translate threat research into deployable ML solutions.
2. AI-Based Telemetry Selector
• Enhanced existing telemetry selection algorithms to better identify high-value features for security modeling, reducing
data collection overhead and improving model efficiency.
• Applied continuous learning techniques to adapt telemetry selection strategies as new attack patterns emerged.
• Built data processing pipelines to collect, clean, and aggregate telemetry across multiple hardware platforms.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate solutions into existing security frameworks.
